text:
Laughing pure fountain—you learn from my eyes to be a river, rushing from eyes sending tears—


if cold traps you in crystal, my tears for Lisida burn you; your flood is mine.


You hoard her image; I lavish tears on your currents, soul and faith on Lisida.


I judged seas bitter and cruel, but not fountains' clear, laughing, sweet water.

translation.title: To a Fountain Where Lisida Came to See Herself
